title: The item 'a tarnished stag clasp' (found in the Vale hunter's camp brush) is flavor-tagged the whole game as 'the elder knows it from his coffer's lid,' pointing at an NPC (the Last Light elder, reachable off the chapel) I never visited. Nothing ever nudges the player back to that NPC, and the item stays permanently unresolved once you cross Coldpass ('what you have left undone elsewhere stays undone').
where: Vale / Hunter's Camp, search the brush past the smoke rack
